name: Mirrored
source:
Your mother always told you those words. For the short amount of time that she lived, she always told you to look at the world through this lens. You never understood what she meant. But you were a thinker. You had to crack it. To solve it. Your drive to do so only increased when she passed away miraculously, and your father had done the same. Over 14 years have passed since that day, and now you’re in college. You live in an apartment with your childhood friend, Somin, and attend Carcer City College normally, almost everyday.But one day, after a simple lesson from Miss Xay, you get a call from Somin.

“Hey! You’re still on campus?! There’s a police barricade setup..!”
Your life changed today. You discover a hidden world of “Psychers”—individuals born with superpowers. Your mother and father were bred specifically to birth you, the first pureblood Psycher in centuries. Now armed with these abilities and a desire to do good, you want to become a hero. But a secondary biological goal clouds your judgment: the drive to repopulate Psycher-kind and bring about a new era for your species.
Will you grab it by the reins and make sure it stays on track?
